caption: The drawing features an ornate rectangular frame with intricate lace-like patterns in shades of beige, brown, and gray, occupying the center of a plain off-white background. The frame is embellished with symmetrical floral and scroll designs along its edges and corners. Inside this ornate border, there is a smaller, similarly shaped inner frame with a scalloped edge, containing a central colored illustration and text. The illustration is a vertical rectangle with a detailed, multicolored floral motif featuring red, yellow, blue, and green hues, with what appears to be a goblet or vase in the center, surrounded by a decorative border composed of alternating blue and red elements with gold accents. Above and below the illustration, there are short lines of black handwritten text. The artist's signature, "Stella Mosher," appears in black ink in the lower right corner outside the ornate frame.
title: Valentine
